ValidationRule.description: Freight Implementation: Quote line item should not be modified once Opportunity closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName == "Freight", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Freight_Quote",
OR( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, "Closed - Accepted"), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, "Closed - Not Accepted") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quote should not be modified once Opportunity is Closed.
